name: Security Posture
description: Top-level threat dashboard: alerts triggered by detection rules, exposed vulnerabilities, exploit-matched software, and MITRE ATT&CK coverage. Start here for a fast triage view.

charts.title: Alerts by Severity
charts.description: Distribution of triggered detection rules by severity. A growing share of high or critical alerts means active threats requiring triage.

charts.title: Top Triggering Rules
charts.description: Rule names firing most often. Reveals the dominant attack patterns in the capture and helps surface noisy or low-fidelity rules that need tuning.

charts.title: Alerts by Protocol
charts.description: Which network protocols generated the most alerts. Concentrated activity on a single protocol (HTTP, DNS, SMB, etc.) is a strong pivot point for investigation.

charts.title: Vulnerabilities by CVSS Score
charts.description: CVSS v2 score distribution across vulnerable software detected on the wire. A heavy upper tail (7.0+) indicates serious exposure that warrants immediate patching.

charts.title: Exploits by Target Platform
charts.description: Platforms (windows / linux / php / multiple / …) for which Exploit-DB matched the observed software. Identifies which OS or runtime in your environment is most exposed.

charts.title: MITRE ATT&CK Tags
charts.description: Frequency of MITRE ATT&CK technique tags from triggered rules. Indicates which kill-chain stages (initial access, execution, exfiltration, …) were exercised in the capture.
